in_tamil.name: Nirdosh
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Innocent, guiltless
in_tamil.long_meaning: Nirdosh ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nirdosha', meaning 'free from faults or sins'. This name is often given to a child believed to be pure and free from any blemish or impurity.

in_telugu.name: Nirdosh
in_telugu.long_meaning: Nirdosh ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nirdosha', meaning 'free from faults or sins'. This name is often given to a child believed to be pure and free from any blemish or impurity.

in_marathi.name: Nirdosh

in_bengali.name: Nirdosh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Innocent, guiltless
